row.team_price_text: Pro: starts at $60/month, billed monthly (teams under 50 employees)
row.evidence: The CoreWeave Forge pricing page lists Single Sign On, "Automated user provisioning" and "User and role management using SCIM API" only on the custom-priced Enterprise plan.
row.notes: Still gated. Weights & Biases is now sold as CoreWeave Forge: wandb.ai/site/pricing redirects to coreweave.com/forge-pricing and the docs moved to docs.coreweave.com. Plans are Free ($0), Pro ('Starts at $60/month, billed monthly', for teams under 50 employees, up to 10 Models seats) and Enterprise (custom, invoiced annually). June's $50/u/mo Pro price no longer appears; the page gives a $60/month starting price without saying it is per user, so per-user fields are null. SCIM is a documented SCIM 2.0-style API with Users, Groups (W&B Teams) and non-standard Roles endpoints; behaviour differs between Multi-tenant Cloud (deactivate removes the user from the org, no reactivation) and Dedicated/Self-Managed (active=false, reactivation supported). The audit-log API is Enterprise-only on Multi-tenant Cloud.

plans.name: Pro
plans.price_text: Starts at $60/month, billed monthly; for teams under 50 employees; up to 10 Models seats
plans.notes: Pricing table marks Single sign-on, SCIM API and Audit Logs with a cross for Pro.

auth.token_source: API key of an organization admin user or an organization-scoped service account (Bearer, or HTTP Basic username:API-KEY)

operations.notes: Reactivation only on Dedicated Cloud / Self-Managed. Teams cannot be deleted via SCIM.

deprovision.data_retained: Dedicated Cloud and Self-Managed keep the user record (active=false); Multi-tenant Cloud removes the user from the organization. DELETE fully deletes the user.

pagination.notes: Docs state a maximum of 9,999 items per request.

custom.how: W&B extension attributes modelsSeat (full/viewer/none), weaveRole and registryAccess on create/update

roles.how: PATCH /scim/Users/{id} assigns organization and team roles; /scim/Roles creates and manages custom roles

limitations.text: Teams cannot be deleted through SCIM.
Multi-tenant Cloud does not support updating displayName or email, or reactivating users, through SCIM.
Operations may fail when organization seat limits are reached; deprovisioning can remove the last admin.

capabilities.notes: Python SDK (wandb.Api): create_user, Team.invite, Member.delete (remove from team).

limitations.text: Non-SCIM user management is exposed through the Python SDK, not a documented REST user API.

okta.notes: Docs say the SCIM API works with Okta; no OIN catalogue page found at okta.com/integrations (weights-and-biases, wandb, weights-biases all 404).

entra.notes: Docs give Entra custom-app tenant URL and attribute mappings; no Entra gallery tutorial found.
